chapter: Road bands: Hucklebuck Williams and Tiny Bradshaw
title: Tiny Bradshaw as a dapper bandleader
summary: Bradshaw is a flashy dresser who plays only in the key of C on piano and then sings.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: learn how to be a professional musician from Tiny Bradshaw's band because for the reason that the three of us--like I said, me and Paul and Bill Hardman--
He was a dude that--he was a real dresser, you know--Tiny Bradshaw, you know.
He--he like to--he was dapper, man. He was touching all the time, you know.
He didn't play any instrument though, did he?
He played one key--key of C--on the piano.
See when he played 'Soft', that's him on the piano.
See, and 'Ping Pong' --that's him on the piano. All them things in the key of C.
You see. And after that he'd get up from the piano and he'd stand over here and go through his other stuff.
His singing and stuff, you know. But exciting, man. He was an exciting man, you know. And uh, and the back of the--in the trunk of his car he had a safe, in the trunk of his car.
